arrangement slot: Drop with kick and bass already present
owner listening check: Distinguish the first hit from the kick and check whether the grain scrape obscures the offbeat bass onset.

arrangement slot: Two-bar F-major pre-lead lift at 126 BPM
owner listening check: Check the third against the chord voicing; audition whether the bell leaves room for the lead at the join.

arrangement slot: Four-bar descending acid color under an exposed kick
owner listening check: Check low-mid masking in the longest gap and whether the final bar moves out of the next phrase quickly enough.

arrangement slot: Sustained loop in a progressive break
owner listening check: Hold multiple passes in the DAW and compare each seam against the rhythm; the staged WAV is one finite pass.

arrangement slot: Short high-register answer to a broken fill
owner listening check: Try different Gate note lengths; assess cymbal masking and whether the release stays clear of the next strike.

arrangement slot: Three-bar 1/8-triplet phrase before a scene change
owner listening check: Contrast the last bar pickup against straight bass and verify that restarting the host does not move the phrase into the neighboring scene.

arrangement slot: Low-motion hold under piano or spoken vocal
owner listening check: Check consonant detail and center occupancy; test a long hold beyond the finite solo reference.

arrangement slot: A-minor end tag following an exposed hook
owner listening check: Check whether the leading call remains distinct from the lead and the side answer is still readable in mono.
